input: Book a professional teeth whitening consultation

gold.taskTitle: Book a Professional Teeth Whitening Consultation
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to schedule a consultation with a dental professional specifically for teeth whitening treatment.

questions.title: Do you already have a dentist you plan to visit?
questions.description: Determine whether the user has an existing dental provider or needs to find a new one.

questions.title: What city or neighborhood should the clinic be in?
questions.description: Identify the preferred location for the dental consultation.

questions.title: How soon do you want the consultation to happen?
questions.description: Establish the urgency or target date for booking the appointment.

questions.title: What days of the week work best for you?
questions.description: Determine the user's weekly availability to narrow down appointment options.

questions.title: What is your budget range for the whitening treatment?
questions.description: Understand the user's financial constraints to help filter appropriate providers.

questions.title: Do you have dental insurance that should cover this?
questions.description: Find out if insurance is a factor that will influence which providers are suitable.

questions.title: Have you had any past sensitivity issues with your teeth?
questions.description: Identify any dental health considerations that may affect the type of whitening treatment recommended.
